full_judgment:
7. The learned Subordinate Judge by his judgment and decree dated 31.5.86 dismissed the suit on contest against the defendants, holding the suit to be not maintainable. 

 8. From the judgment and decree dated 31.5.86 of the Subordinate Judge, Moulvi Bazar dismissing Title Suit No. 18 of 1983 the plaintiff-petitioners preferred Title Appeal No. 145 of 1986. In the apple, the plaintiffs-appellants petitioners filed an application on 4.11.1991 for withdrawal of the appeal to enable them to file fresh suit in the Court of the District Judge. That the application was allowed by the learned District Judge to withdraw the appeal but not the suit with permission to sue afresh vide Order No. 61 dated 4.11.1991. The appeal was evidently kept pending.
